description:
Wire the baked GEMM tiles' selection sites and migrate the AXPY volume threshold to a runtime resolved read.

## Background

The follow-on selector migration design (dev/active/7d824b2f/design.md) governs this task; read it in full. Its §2 fixes the two field kinds and the mechanism rule with four structural read-pattern obligations, §3 gives every field its name, range, default-naming constant, read site and mechanism, §4 names the route reporter and test obligation per family, and §5.3 states the ratified amortisation screening rule and the behaviour-preservation argument (defaults name the in-source constants; observable behaviour unchanged when no profile is installed). Design §3.7 and the gemm row of §4.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: row_tile and col_tile resolve through the baked constants at all seven blocked-loop sites, and axpy_fast_path_min_volume is a runtime resolved read, all satisfying design §2.3 with arithmetic unchanged.
- [hard] REQ-02: gemm_axpy_route reporter called by the dispatcher, its route files, and the baked tile witness (wired into the CI baked step) pass; tests sizing operands from the tiles follow the baked constants unchanged.
- [hard] REQ-03: Rustdoc names the profile fields; existing tests pass unchanged.
title: Cut the GEMM selectors over to the tuning profile
